scope: Theorem 5.1 (Exact purely inseparable genus estimate) of the manuscript “The Blockwise Alperin Weight Conjecture” (preprints/The-Blockwise-Alperin-Weight-Conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 202 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 042c7730f058d508), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix h ≥ 1 and take s ≥ h such that ps−h > m (︁ h + logp m )︁ . (5.1) Let F/F0 be finite with [F : F0]p ≤ ph, and let Z be the normalization of EF in a finite purely inseparable extension of its function field of degree d ≤ m. Choose a compositum S = FF′. The curve ZS is integral and regular. Let ri be the ramification index of ZS → ES at the unique point over ti. With ν(Z) computed over F, one has ν(Z) d ≥ n ∑︂ i=1 (︃ 1 − 1 ri )︃ . (5.2) The bound is uniform in F, Z, and the tuple-class multiset used later in the counting argument.
